claim: DATABASE CHOICE (example atom, delete me): we chose Postgres over MySQL for the main DB (2026-01-10); the reasons live in the source file, so nobody re-litigates it. A plain atom like this is recalled when a message reaches its topic.
PROD MIGRATIONS (example boot atom, delete me): never run a migration against prod without a backup first. A standing safety rule every session needs, whatever the topic, is what the boot tag is for.
